svg.title: Voltstream containers and data flow
svg.desc: Meters publish to the meter.readings topic. The speed layer consumes it, upserts speed views in PostgreSQL and sends invalid records to the rejects table and to a dead-letter topic nothing reads. The raw archiver appends every record to the master dataset. The batch layer rescans it with the day's tariff from the landing bucket, writes batch views and commits the run ledger; the speed layer prices with the previous day's tariff. The API reads PostgreSQL and the dashboard polls the API.
